stills.prompt: A candid phone photo in a sunny cafe: the closed bag sits on a small wooden table beside a little A-frame chalkboard stand; the chalk lettering is big, hand-drawn white on black slate, 2-3 short lines, easy to read on a phone; warm window light, shallow depth of field, a latte cup at the edge, nobody in the picture; real textures, nothing glossy. The closed black bag stands on a small round wooden cafe table next to a little A-frame chalkboard stand with an empty slate (the words go on it), a latte in a white cup at the table's edge, soft sunny window light from the left, a softly blurred cafe behind. The exact handbag from the reference image, unchanged: same colour, same shape and proportions, same handles or straps, same zipper pulls and hardware, same stitching and finish. Do not redesign it. The handbag is closed and zipped; its inside is never shown. The only words in the image, each exactly once and spelled exactly as written: "BLACK FRIDAY SPECIAL" / "HOBO 2.0" / "50% OFF". Set them as clean, legible type, big, sharp and easy to read on a small phone screen (the main line spans most of the picture's width), never over the handbag. No other text anywhere: no logos, no brand names, no labels or writing on the handbag, no watermark. Nobody is in the picture, not even blurred in the background. Every photographic part looks like a real photograph: true-to-life light and colour, real textures and materials, small natural imperfections, nothing glossy, plastic or computer-generated. Portrait 4:5 composition, the handbag large and clearly visible.

steps: 1. Upload each distinct `ref` once (media_upload, curl PUT, media_confirm); generate every still with generate_image_batch (model/params/prompt as listed, medias [{value: media_id, role: image_references}], max 12 per call); jobs_wait; download each result to $OUT/<file>.

2. python3 pipeline/ai_gen.py gate --out $OUT ; LOOK at $OUT/qa/ai_stills.jpg (reference | still): reject any still where the bag's shape, colour, handles or hardware differ from the reference, or that looks AI: python3 pipeline/ai_gen.py reject --out $OUT AS03 ...

3. For every clip whose start still passed: generate_video_batch (start_image = that still's job id, model/params/prompt as listed); jobs_wait; download to $OUT/<file>. Clips of a rejected still are skipped. If a submission comes back with a preset recommendation instead of a job, send it again with `declined_preset_id` = that preset's id (the project never uses presets).
4. python3 pipeline/ai_gen.py clips --out $OUT ; LOOK at $OUT/qa/ai_clips.jpg; reject morphing / odd-hand clips with `reject`. Then render as usual (it applies the result).
Report: credits before -> after (balance), how many AI assets passed. Never ship a still or clip you would not believe is real.
